'''Marse Deboora''' was the [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of [[Sinya Deboora]], [[Seltos]]' [[Magister of Trade]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was a staunch supporter of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
